numbering_policy: Contiguous dashboard numbers in the relative frozen YAML order of the statistic name itself; original corpus folders and ordinals remain unchanged.
ids_policy: Dashboard number, original corpus ordinal, upstream numeric Linguist language_id and opaque GitHub GraphQL ID are separate.
color_policy: Present names use actual GitHub GraphQL color including null; pending names use upstream YAML color. Null has neutral UI fallback, not an invented GitHub color.
